title: Generating Critic-Guided Synthetic Experience in Latent World Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.39100v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Learning from offline datasets is limited in scalability, as collecting new experience is often costly or unsafe in the real world. World models offer an alternative way to generate new experience through a learned dynamics model, yet learning policies in latent space is limited due to compounding errors in imagined rollouts. To this end, we propose using the world model as a local transition generator, leveraging critic guidance to choose actions inside that model to generate synthetic experiences. We study action refinement methodologies, introducing Critic-Guided Synthetic Experience (CGSE) generation in world models. Specifically, CGSE augments an existing offline dataset by sampling candidate actions using an offline policy and refining each to maximize a first-order approximation of the $Q$-function within a trust region. translated_title: 在潜在世界模型中生成评论家引导的合成经验
translated_abstract: 从离线数据集中学习在可扩展性方面存在局限，因为在现实世界中收集新经验往往成本高昂或不安全。世界模型提供了一种替代方案，可以通过学习到的动力学模型生成新经验，然而在潜空间中学习策略受到想象回放中复合误差的限制。为此，我们提出将世界模型用作局部转移生成器，利用评论家引导在该模型内选择动作以生成合成经验。我们研究了动作优化方法，提出了世界模型中的评论家引导合成经验生成方法（CGSE）。具体而言，CGSE通过使用离线策略采样候选动作，并在信任域内对每个动作进行优化以最大化Q函数的一阶近似，从而增强现有的离线数据集。随后，我们使用冻结的潜在世界模型想象每个更新动作后的未来状态，并利用评论家…（摘要截断）
tldr: 本文提出评论家引导的合成经验生成方法（CGSE），将世界模型作为局部转移生成器，在信任域内利用Q函数一阶近似优化离线策略采样的候选动作，并用冻结的潜在世界模型想象未来状态，从而有效增强离线数据集。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Critic-Guided Synthetic Experience (CGSE) generation, which uses the world model as a local transition generator to refine candidate actions sampled by an offline policy—maximizing a first-order Q-function approximation within a trust region—and imagines future states with a frozen latent world model to augment offline datasets.
